name: Stone stairs
description: A flight of worn stone steps, 1.5 m wide and 3 m long, between two dark blue-grey ashlar crypt walls 3 m high, with a raking string course along both walls and heavy lintels roofing the far end. Going down, the treads sink step by step under an ever lower ceiling into darkness; going up, the steps rise under a lintel to a dark opening.

provenance.prompt: stairs_stone_down: worn stone steps going down into darkness between two side walls, about 1.5 × 3 m, the deep end dark. stairs_stone_up: the same flight seen from below, rising to a dark opening. Crypt wall kit palette; the flight runs along y, the way on at -y.
